title: Email and Text Message Use by Placement Stage, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Channel matrix from the compliance manual for **Placed Consumer Accounts**: whether Ridgeline uses email, and whether it uses text messages, for collection communications at each placement stage.

| Stage | Email used for collection communications | Text messages used for collection communications |
|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | Yes | Yes |
| Primary Placement | Yes | Yes |
| Secondary Placement | Yes | Yes |
| Tertiary Placement | Yes | No |
| Warehouse Placement | No | No |
| Legal Review Placement | No | No |

## Reading the matrix

- Early-Out Placement, Primary Placement and Secondary Placement use both channels.
- Tertiary Placement uses email but not text messages.
- Warehouse Placement and Legal Review Placement use neither channel for collection communications.

The matrix states the company's own use of each channel at each stage. A row reading "No" means Ridgeline does not use that channel for collection communications on accounts at that stage.
